book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso gwenyɛ ajii a muh wù ba gɛ̀ boyɛ wù nyu kinfeeŋ
No Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu jiɛnyi, wu yɛŋ jwɛŋsɛ wumu le ba gɛ̀ boyi wu wù nyu wa kinfeeŋ.
Booŋ bɛ ba ŋgoo, biih wu le lɛ, “Labai, gɛ̀ ge yɛɛŋ kimbefɛ fɛ ba boo muh wunɛ nyu wu feeŋ wa? Gɛ̀ ge muh wunɛ, noo bwee bɛ chiji le?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ nyu muh wunɛ gɛ, kɛnɛ bwee bɛ chiji bò gɛ̀ ge kimbefɛ gɛ. Ba gɛ̀ boyi wu noo lɛ lɛme chi Nyo ge chi dunyɛ ye yi ye ye le.
Bee kɛme ki bee lɛ̂ne lɛme chi muh wù tuŋ mɛ baaŋ fɛnshɛ. Kintaŋ too lo nyu kife kì taŋlo wu gɛ lɛŋ fiɛɛ gɛ.
Gɛɛne bude sege la no nle yi woŋ kfunɛ le, le mɛ wù le n'yulɛ wu yi woŋ kfunɛ le.”

content: No Jiso jɛme njɛmɛ wunɛ, wu mo wu chvuuyɛ nchwene fɛkuu, wu tojɛ nshɛŋ wu mo wu yefɛ ajii a muh wɛɛ yu,
wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ̂nɛ wo chûgɛ a Kinchvuuŋ ki Siloŋ le.”

content: (Jee chi Siloŋ le lɛ, “Ba tuŋ lo.”) Wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu chugɛ, wu kaase wu too wu yɛde wa mwɛɛ le.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ chee mbebe ye le, mo bamii ba gɛ̀ shee bo yɛde wu le njɛ muh kilɛgɛ bo tu bo ghaade lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛh muh wɛɛ wu chi bee wu shiide wu lɛge kilɛgɛ?”
Bamu tu bo duu lɛ, “Le wu.” Bamu lɛ, “Aay, wu fiɛɛnɛ lo wu.” Muh wɛɛ jɛmɛ lɛ, “Le mɛ wuyu.”
Noo, bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Ajii a wo ge nɛɛ fɛ a gwenyɛ?”
Wu chvuu lɛ, “Muh wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Jiso be wu tojɛ nshɛŋ wu yefɛ ajii a waŋ yu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ nchûgɛ Siloŋ. Mɛ mo ŋgɛɛŋ nchugɛ, ajii a waŋ mo a gwenyɛ ye.”
Bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wu le faaŋ?” Wu chvuu lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee gɛ.”
Kiŋgaye to antɛnɛɛ a Bafalashii kune bvuŋga bvu Jiso
Bo mo bo ja bo jo muh wɛɛ wu gɛ̀ shee wù nyu wu feeŋ bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ Bafalashii le.
Juu chì Jiso gɛ̀ tojɛ nshɛŋ wu ka wu gwenyɛ ajii a muh wɛɛ yu gɛ̀ bee juu chi yuuŋ.
Bafalashii baa ka bo biih tɛ wu le no wu ge ajii awe kaa wo gwenyɛ. Wu chvuu bo le lɛ, “Wu be wu yefɛ ajii awaŋ bɛ nshɛŋ, ŋgɛɛŋ nchugɛ mɛ mo tu n'yɛde mwɛɛ le.”

Bafalashii mo bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ muh wunɛ ja fɛ Nyo le gɛ, nje wu lɛne juu chi yuuŋ.” Bamu jɛmɛ fiboo lɛ, “Taŋlo muh wù gee bimbefɛ jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ wù gee kfuu chi munɛ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo?” Kiŋgaye mo ki to a bo ntɛnɛɛ.
Bo ka bo kaasɛ bo biih muh wɛɛ le lɛ, “Wo jɛme fiuŋ lɛ la kune muh wɛɛ no wu be gwenyɛ ajii awo?” Wu chvuu lɛ, “Muh wɛɛ le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo.”
Gɛ Bajuu gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ lɛ muh wɛɛ gɛ̀ shee wù nyu wu feeŋ gɛ fɛ ba gwenyɛ ajii awe gɛ. Ba gɛ jiɛnyɛ ba tɛɛŋ bwee bɛ chiji bo to.
Ba biih bo le lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛ mwa wene wù bɛŋ duu lɛ ba gɛ̀ boo wu wù nyu wa kinfeeŋ? Wu ge nɛɛ fɛ wu ka wu yɛde mwɛɛ le mɛɛse?”
Bwee bɛ chiji chvuu lɛ, “Bee kee lo lɛ wunɛ le mwa wese wù bee gɛ̀ boyɛ wù nyu wu feeŋ wa.
Geenɛ, kɛnɛ fi tu ge nɛɛ fɛ wu tu wu yɛde mwɛɛ le mɛɛse gɛ̀ bee kɛɛ gɛ. Gɛ bee kɛɛ tɛ muh wu gwenyi ajii awe gɛ. Bɛŋ, biih nyu wu le. Wu le wa muh wu a jii yuu wu. Wu taŋlo wu jɛmɛ fɛ kikwɛɛ ke le.”
Bwee bɛ chiji gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje bo gɛ̀ faane Bajuu, fi nyu Bajuu gɛ̀ leesɛ wa lɛ muh moŋ lo wu jɛmɛ bɛ jwe we lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, ba kuŋ lo mwɛdɛ yeh yi buunɛ le.
Le fiɛɛ fì bwee bɛ chiji gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ wu le wa muh wu ajii yuu wu, lɛ bo biih nyu wu le.
Yi kiŋgane kinfɛɛ le, bo ka bo tɛɛŋ muh wɛɛ wù gɛ̀ shee wù nyu wu feeŋ wa, bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Tee fiɛɛ fì nchiɛɛŋ mbɛɛŋsɛ gɛ̂ɛŋ fɛ Nyo le. Bee kee fiesa lɛ muh wunɛ le muh wù gee bimbefɛ.”
Wu chvuu lɛ, “Kɛnɛ wù gee bimbefɛ, tu gɛ ŋkee gɛ. Fiɛɛ fimimia fì ŋkee le gɛh lɛ nchi mbee nyu nfeeŋ, mɛɛse n'yɛde wa mwɛɛ le.”
Bo ka bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wu be ge nɛɛ bɛ wo? Wu be ge nɛɛ fɛ wu gwenyɛ ajii awo?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ, “Mbe nsɛɛŋ wa bɛŋ le, bɛŋ baaŋ koŋ gɛ ki bɛŋ yû gɛ. Bɛŋ ka goone ki bɛŋ yû bɛŋ ge la? Bɛŋ tɛ goone ki bɛŋ nyû bamii be ba ŋgoo lɛ?”
Bo naanyɛ lo wu bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Le wo wu le muh we wu ŋgoo. Bee le fiesa bamii ba ŋgoo ba Musɛ.
Bee kee lo lɛ Musɛ le wu wù Nyo gɛ̀ shee wu jɛme bɛ wu. Geenɛ muh wunɛ gɛ̀ bee kee a wu bu yo gɛ.”
Muh wɛɛ chvuu lɛ, “Habaay! Finɛ le lo kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ lɛ! Bɛŋ duu lɛ gɛ bɛŋ kee a wu bu yo gɛ? Geenɛ wu le wu gwenyɛ ajii awaŋ.
Bee kee lo lɛ gɛ Nyo to wu yuge buunɛ chi muh wù gee bimbefɛ gɛ. Geenɛ, muh nɛ ŋgvuune Nyo, wù gee fiɛɛ fì wu goone, tu Nyo lé wu yûge buunɛ che.
Kɛge no woŋ gɛ̀ kɛ bo gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ lɛ muh le wu gwenyɛ ajii a muh wu ba gɛ̀ boyɛ wu wù nyu wu feeŋ wa gɛ.
Nɛ fi be baaŋ nyu gɛ lɛ muh wunɛ ja fɛ Nyo le gɛ, tu gɛ wu bee no wu ge fiɛɛ gɛ.”
Bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo le ba gɛ̀ boyi wo wuchii a bimbefɛ ntɛnɛɛ, wo tu wo goone ki wo yɛ̂yi bee?” No bo jɛmɛ noo, bo mo bo kuŋ wu a bo ntɛnɛɛ.
Muh wu le wu feeŋ yi fiɛɛ fì Nyo le
No Jiso yu lɛ ba le ba kuŋ wa muh wɛɛ a bo ntɛnɛɛ, wu gooŋ wu wu yɛŋ wu le, wu biih wu le lɛ, “Wo le wo leesɛ fitele yi muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le?”
Wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wɛɛ le yɛɛŋ chii? Gɛh sɛɛŋ mɛ, wu lɛ nlee fitele yi ye ye le.”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le wo yɛŋ wa wu le. Le wu wù bena wu jɛme mɛɛse.”

content: Muh wɛɛ mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Tada nle nleesɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu tuŋ anyuu a wu fwe wu nya ŋgvunɛ wu le.
Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nto yi woŋ kfunɛ le lɛ ba sa bamii, ba yɛde gɛ mwɛɛ le gɛ bo yɛ̂ne, bo yɛde mwɛɛ le, tu binfeeŋ.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, Bafalashii ba gɛ̀ bee mbebe ye le bo yu bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Bee tɛ le binfeeŋ?”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ bɛŋ bee binfeeŋ, tu chiaaŋ yene bee yɛse yi bimbefɛ le. Geenɛ mɛɛse bɛŋ duu lɛ bɛŋ yɛde mwɛɛ le, bimbefɛ biɛna le bi mɛ gɛh yi bikwɛɛ biɛna le.”
